notes.title: BOHEMIAN KILLING in German, French, Spanish and Italian!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25720430/5eac3d5f45ab27ccd0e994b192eb3da14296c7f7.jpg[/img]

We're happy to announce a massive language update to Bohemian Killing.

While the game has already been available in English, Polish, and Japanese, now players from Germany, France, Spain and Italy can experience this crime drama fully subtitled in their native languages, bringing the total to seven languages!

The audio narrative of the captivating story is provided by Hollywood actor Stephane Cornicard (“Spectre“, “Saving Private Ryan“).

notes.title: Bohemian Killing now available in 4k
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25720430/ce9854efb62fd377a45389905d7d047801b5996d.png[/img]

Bohemian Killing has received a graphic overhaul to allow modern gaming setups to run the game in full 4k resolution on PC and Mac.
 
The winner of the “Best Story” Award at the Pixel Awards 2016 has received new 4k textures, an overhaul of the game’s lighting and a series of new graphics- and image effects. 

The game now offers additional resolution options, running in 2560x1440 and 3840x2160. 

The narrative-driven courtroom drama set in a 19th century steampunk Paris is the first game of its kind created by a real-life lawyer.

notes.title: Bohemian Killing Update - Japanese support & performance improvements
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25720430/25701edb76619ba11f25a836dcbeed932280ff73.png[/img]

We're very happy to announce that full [b]Japanese[/b] localization (user interface, subtitles, and voice overs) is now available in Bohemian Killing! 

We have also improved the overall performance and graphics quality, and decreased the size of the game! Bohemian Killing now works faster, and looks prettier than ever!

Thank you for all your support!

notes.title: New update, new DLC, and a huge sale!
notes.content:
[b]Save 25% on Bohemian Killing, enjoy new DLC, and try updated version of the game![/b]

Thank you all for your positive comments, and great feedback! We've listened to your opinions, and improved the game even more! What's new?
1. Shorter loading times, and better performance.
2. Detailed information about unlocked endings at the end of each playthrough.
3. New interactions, and possibilities.
4. Language improvements.
5. Minor bug fixes.

We've also released a new DLC - [b]Bohemian Killing - Original Soundtrack and Artbooks[/b] - it features [b]15 minutes of original music composed by Marcin Maślanka:[/b]
1. [b]Main Theme[/b] - 3:08 min,
2. [b]Second Theme (female vocals)[/b] - 1:42 min,
3. [b]Underscore[/b] - 6:12 min,
4. [b]Waltz Gypsy[/b] - 1:23 min,
5. [b]Waltz Parisian[/b] - 0:52 min,
6. [b]Cue 1[/b] - 0:19 min,
7. [b]Cue 2[/b] - 0:07 min,
8. [b]Cue 3[/b] - 0:15 min,
9. [b]Cue 4[/b] - 0:12 min,
10. [b]Cue 5[/b] - 0:05 min,

and [b]printable, digital materials:[/b]
1. [b]Guide to Paris[/b] - discover real locations, characters and events presented in Bohemian Killing,
2. [b]Prosecutor's files[/b] - all evidences, expertises, photographs, and testimonies from the game,
3. [b]Wanted poster[/b] of Alfred Ethon,
4. Two customizable (add your own name, and date) certificates - [b]Certificate of Acquittal,[/b] and [b]Certificate of Death Sentence.[/b]

You can buy it separately, or in a bundle containing the game, and the DLC!

notes.title: First update :)
notes.content:
Thank you all for your comments, and feedback! In the past few days we uploaded few updates - fixing the issues mentioned by you, and adding new content to the game. List of changes:

1. New interactions to improve your line of defense, and new ways to skip in-game time.
2. New possibilities to interact with Marie Capet in your apartment, adding new, and unique ways to alter your testimony.
3. Improved murder scenes, and more obvious possibility to commit a murder of passion.
4. Improved interactions that were easily missed by players.
5. Improved colliders, character movement, camera rotation, and mouse sensitivity.
6. Improved loading screens, and loading times.
7. Other bug fixes.
